#include <iostream>

#include <functional>

using namespace std;

const double EPSILON = 1e-8;

double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
    return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
}

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    bool operator==(const Point& o) const {
        return fabs(x - o.x) <= EPSILON && fabs(y - o.y) <= EPSILON;
    }
    double distance(const Point& o) const {
        return fastHypot(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;
    Circle() {}
    Circle(const Point& c, double r) : center(c), radius(r) {}
    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double dist = center.distance(other.center);
        if (dist < EPSILON) return {};
        double a = 2 * (other.center.x - center.x);
        double b = 2 * (other.center.y - center.y);
        double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius + center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x + center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
        double h = fastHypot(a, b);
        a /= h;
        b /= h;
        c /= h;
        // Now line: a*x + b*y + c = 0
        // Intersection with this circle
        double dx = -a * c;
        double dy = -b * c;
        double d = fabs(c); // distance from center (0,0) to line
        if (d > radius + EPSILON) return {};
        Point inter(dx + center.x, dy + center.y);
        if (fabs(d - radius) < EPSILON) return {inter};
        double shift = sqrt(radius * radius - d * d);
        return {Point(inter.x + shift * b, inter.y - shift * a),
                Point(inter.x - shift * b, inter.y + shift * a)};
    }
};

struct IntArrayList {
    vector<int> data;
    IntArrayList() {}
    explicit IntArrayList(int cap) { data.reserve(cap); }
    void add(int val) { data.push_back(val); }
    int get(int idx) const { return data[idx]; }
    int size() const { return (int)data.size(); }
    void addAt(int index, int value) {
        if (index > (int)data.size()) throw out_of_range("addAt");
        data.insert(data.begin() + index, value);
    }
    void removeAt(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= (int)data.size()) throw out_of_range("removeAt");
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
    }
};

int find(vector<int>& parent, int x) {
    while (parent[x] != x) {
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];
        x = parent[x];
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i] >> r[i];
    }
    
    vector<Circle> circles;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        circles.emplace_back(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
    }
    
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            vector<Point> inter = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            for (const Point& p : inter) {
                points.push_back(p);
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<bool> bad(points.size(), false);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)points.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (points[i] == points[j]) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    int nVertices = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)points.size(); i++) {
        if (!bad[i]) nVertices++;
    }
    
    int nEdges = 0;
    vector<int> parent(points.size());
    vector<int> rank(points.size(), 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)points.size(); i++) parent[i] = i;
    int setCount = (int)points.size();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int current = 0;
        IntArrayList onThis;
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)points.size(); j++) {
            if (!bad[j] && fabs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - circles[i].radius) < EPSILON) {
                current++;
                onThis.add(j);
            }
        }
        for (int j = 1; j < onThis.size(); j++) {
            int a = find(parent, onThis.get(j));
            int b = find(parent, onThis.get(0));
            if (a != b) {
                if (rank[a] < rank[b]) swap(a, b);
                else if (rank[a] == rank[b]) rank[a]++;
                parent[b] = a;
                setCount--;
            }
        }
        nEdges += max(current, 1);
    }
    
    int badCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)bad.size(); i++) {
        if (bad[i]) badCount++;
    }
    int nComponents = setCount - badCount;
    
    cout << 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
